ns2:course.label: Special Topics for Non-Majors
ns2:course.description: Allows students to explore a revolving series of genres, specializations, and /or interdisciplinary practices. Possible subjects include, but are not limited to, site-specific public art, recycled and sustainable materials, performance, sound, or emerging technology. Topics and subject matter to be published in course listings. May be repeated to a maximum of 6 hours in separate terms.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: May be repeated to a maximum of 6 hours in separate terms.
